### Don't overpay!

Pay today’s price for travel later so you can secure flights and hotel prices before they increase. Book today and pay over time with Zip. 

### Fly now, pay later 

Last minute travel can be pricey but when you pay for flights or accommodations with Zip, you can spread the cost of your trip over time. It’s easier to be flexible when you can pay later. 

### Travel how you want

Whether you’re an all-inclusive traveler, glamping in the desert or someone who treats themselves to experiences, Zip gives you the flexibility to pay later for everything from flights to concert tickets and excursions to restaurants! 

### Where can I pay later for travel with Zip?
Pay later where you want for travel. Whether it’s a splurge at a hotel for two or a family vacation at a theme park, Zip is here to help you pay later at all your favorite ways to get away. 

- Southwest
- American Airlines
- Delta
- United
- Airbnb 
- Hotels.com
- Expedia
- Marriott
- Hilton
- And so many more! Check them out in the Zip app<disclaimer id="us-tila-disclaimer" />

## How it works: 

1. Download the Zip app and search for flights, hotels, car rentals and more. 
2. Create a one time virtual card in the app to pay for your travel purchase. 
3. Pack your bags! Make your 4 payments for your purchase with Zip over 6 weeks<disclaimer id="us-tila-disclaimer" />. 

## FAQ

### Can I purchase flights and hotels now and pay later? 

Yes! Zip gives you the flexibility to book travel now and pay over time. 

### What apps help you pay later for travel?  

The Zip app lets you book travel now and pay later. Whether you take the road more or less traveled, Zip is here to help you travel how you want. 

### What airlines and hotels offer buy now, pay later?

The Zip app gives you the flexibility to pay later where you want. That includes almost any airlines or hotel!<disclaimer id="us-tila-disclaimer" /> 

### How do I buy now, pay later for travel with Zip?

- Download the Zip app 
- Search for flights and/or accommodations in the Zip app
- Tap “Pay with Zip” when you’re ready to book your trip
- Zip pays for your purchase price and you pay in 4 over 6 weeks<disclaimer id="us-tila-disclaimer" />

### Can I travel before my trip is paid off?

Yes! When you use Zip at check out, you’ll be ready for take off, even if the travel occurs during your payment schedule. 

### Can I pay later for flights at Delta, United, American Airlines, or Southwest Airlines?

Yes! The Zip app gives you the flexibility to pay later where you want at all major airlines, including Delta, United, American Airlines, and Southwest Airlines.<disclaimer id="us-tila-disclaimer" />
